faq: Do I keep my existing content?
Yes. Text, images, page names and settings carry over, and only the look changes. We note how the site looked before we start, so there is always a point to compare against.
Can I keep my template but change how it looks?
Yes. Squarespace lets you restyle fonts, colors, spacing and layouts without changing templates. For very large changes we suggest a fresh start on a new layout and explain why.
Will the redesign affect my SEO?
We aim to protect it by keeping page addresses, headings and titles, and redirecting anything that moves. A fresh, faster layout can help visitors too. We cannot promise rankings.
Do you create new photos or a logo?
No. We use what you provide and resize it. A new logo or photography is a separate job. We can place new files you supply, and we flag weak images in the handover.
desc:
A Squarespace redesign for a fresh new look updates fonts, colors, spacing and layouts while your text, page names and search titles stay in place. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds your pages in Fluid Engine, resizes images and checks the phone layout as carefully as the desktop one.

## What is a Squarespace redesign?

A Squarespace redesign is a new visual treatment for a site that already exists. The pages, wording and structure that work are kept. The look changes: typography, color palette, spacing, buttons, header, footer and the way sections are arranged on each page.

It differs from a new build because your content is the starting point, and from small edits because the whole site is made to agree with itself.

## Why an aging design costs you attention

Sites age even when nothing is broken. Fonts that were fashionable years ago feel dated, spacing was set for older screens, and sections added over time no longer match. Visitors do not analyze this. They simply form an impression that the business is behind the times.

A redesign resets that impression. It also gives you the chance to fix practical issues that built up, such as oversized photos, crowded menus and phone layouts that were never tested.

## How a new design changes what visitors do

Design directs behavior. A stronger hierarchy shows people which heading to read first. Roomier spacing makes text easier to scan on a phone. A consistent button style makes it obvious what can be clicked, and refreshed product or gallery layouts show your work at its best.

Faster pages help as well. When images are resized and heavy sections are simplified, pages open sooner, and that supports both visitors and search visibility. A redesign cannot promise results, but it removes the visual reasons people hesitate.

## What a thoughtful redesign includes

- A short review of what to keep and what to change.
- A proposal for fonts, colors and spacing before any building starts.
- Site styles set once, so buttons and headings stay consistent.
- Rebuilt sections in Fluid Engine, with phone layouts checked.
- A refreshed header and footer.
- Product page, gallery or portfolio layouts restyled.
- Images resized for faster loading.
- Page names, text and search titles carried over.
- A preview link, so you see the result before it goes live.

## How we work

After the review we send the new direction for your approval. We then rebuild pages in your account, using your existing text and images, and share a preview link. Only after your go-ahead do the changes go public.

The Basic package refreshes the home page and one more page. Standard extends to several pages and the shop, with fonts and buttons set through site styles. Premium covers a full redesign with custom section designs, light code for finer details, a speed and mobile pass, and old addresses kept or redirected. We do not create new photography or a logo unless you add that separately.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Collect sites whose style you admire and tell us why.
- Decide in advance which pages and text must not change.
- Supply your logo files and brand colors.
- Check the preview on a phone and a laptop.

**Avoid:**
- Redesigning and rewriting everything at once.
- Choosing trendy fonts that are hard to read.
- Keeping every old section out of habit.
- Publishing before checking your forms and links.

## Who this is for

A long-standing business with strong content but a tired look benefits most. A photographer whose portfolio no longer shows the work well needs a better gallery. A shop owner with loyal customers but a cluttered product layout wants a calmer design.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, your brand files and a few examples you like. We never ask for passwords. Invite us to your Squarespace account as a contributor with permission to edit pages and styles. If you are unsure which version your site uses, we will check when we start.
